thread:
rachel: quick postmortem follow-up — we saw the inference fleet spike on tail-latency yesterday and burned ~45% of a weekly error budget for the customer-facing hosted tier. thinking we should: rebaseline the p95/p99 targets, update the SLO page + dashboard, and capture a repeat-failure hypothesis list. who can own what?
kevin: I can take dashboard updates and add a 'recent regressions' panel. ETA EOW? :thumbsup:
maria: i looked at traces — most spikes correlate with long prompts + KV-cache miss patterns on quantized variants. hypothesis: cache warming + batching mismatch. adding that to the postmortem doc now.
aj: for the SLO side I want to propose shifting p99 target from 200ms -> 260ms for the hosted tier for 2 weeks while we test batching changes. we should be explicit about rolling the target back if backend optimizations land.
rachel: @aj ok can you write the rebaseline proposal (target values + rollback criteria) and put it in the action tracker? set an owner for each rollback gating check.
aj: yep — i'll draft it. proposed fields: current target, proposed target, rationale, measurement query, rollback signal, owner, deadline.
kevin: dashboard bits — i need the exact prometheus queries. sample panel I'll add: ```
# p99 latency (ms) last 7d
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) * 1000
```
kevin: adding an alert rule tied to error budget burn too. prefer a 10% burn/week threshold.
maria: for remediation list: 1) enable aggressive prefix caching on quantized variants (owner: @maria, target: 4/3) 2) tune batching window for short/long prompt mixes (owner: @aj, target: 4/5) 3) add a synthetic probe for 95/99p latency with varied prompt lengths (owner: @kevin, target: 4/1).
ops-bot: incident 2026-02-28-9876 updated: postmortem link -> https://redwood.internal/postmortems/9876 — follow-ups created.
deploy-bot: canary rollout for batching tweak scheduled 2026-04-04 22:00 UTC (canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%).
rachel: good. two admin asks: (1) make sure the action tracker has clear 'acceptance criteria' for rollback, not just owners; (2) for recurring pattern detection, please add a short note in dashboards tagging incidents that match the KV-cache miss signature so we can query trend.
kevin: will add a taggable column on the incident dashboard and add a saved filter for 'kv-cache-miss-like' traces.
aj: timeline: i'll have the rebaseline doc + rollback criteria by 4/2 COB. maria + kevin will have dashboard + probes by 4/3. we'll reconvene 4/4 after canary results and decide if the temporary SLO is needed. sound ok?
maria: sounds good to me.
kevin: ok, creating the dashboard PR now. :eyes:
rachel: thanks all — i'll update the postmortem with owners + deadlines and ping this thread when done. :alarm_clock:
